svg.text: Same 60,000 direct paths for LSMC and Hybrid; values shown as percentages against the fixed 1200-step references.
Strikes: 110, 100, 90, 80, 70. Euler steps: 24, 48, 72, 96. Both methods use 60,000 direct paths.
Hybrid is most favorable in the middle of the step grid.
48 to 72 steps is the strongest region in the combined study.
SE and CI width stay much smaller for Hybrid at the same paths.
